import re

def slugify_v1(text):
    """Current implementation"""
    text = text.strip().lower()
    return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", text).strip("-")

def slugify_v2(text):
    """Alternative: strip after regex"""
    text = text.strip().lower()
    result = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", text)
    return result.strip("-")

def slugify_v3(text):
    """Alternative: use rstrip and lstrip"""
    text = text.strip().lower()
    result = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", text)
    return result.lstrip("-").rstrip("-")

# Test all versions
test_cases = [
    "Hello World",
    "  a   b  ",
    "C++ rocks!",
    "-test-",
    "---",
]

for test in test_cases:
    r1 = slugify_v1(test)
    r2 = slugify_v2(test)
    r3 = slugify_v3(test)
    print(f"Input: {repr(test)}")
    print(f"  v1: {repr(r1)}")
    print(f"  v2: {repr(r2)}")
    print(f"  v3: {repr(r3)}")
    print(f"  All match: {r1 == r2 == r3}")
    print()
EOF
